rejections.evidence: At commit 62607c1e82c1697b8fcec5839ab9ea075aad6b15, DefaultCookieJar._check returns `cookie.cookie.secure && scheme == 'https' || !_isExpired(cookie)`. Under Dart operator precedence, an unexpired Secure cookie is therefore returned for an HTTP request, and an expired Secure cookie is returned for HTTPS. The repository tests contain no Secure-cookie case to catch either behavior.
rejections.reconsider: Reconsider after the predicate enforces both Secure transport and expiration independently and regression tests cover secure HTTP rejection, secure HTTPS acceptance, and expired secure cookies.
